incident-bot: Pager: HOSTED-API high 5xx rate in eu-west-1 · 1799990000
incident-bot: Alert level: page (oncall) · 1799990000
lee (oncall): joining bridge now. seeing 5xx spike ~10:00 UTC, routing errors + backend timeouts. switching primary->eu-west-1 route?
maya: i'm looking at the gateway logs, a couple of upstreams (inference-runtime-pool-3) returning 502s. KV cache pressure on those nodes.
lee (oncall): ok set secondary to @tj for coverage. @tj you good to be secondary?
tj: got it, i'm secondary. i'll pull metric dashboards and check node swarm.
sophia: FYI customers: a handful of requests are getting degraded responses (shortened output) — likely fallback path kicking in. tracking customer impact on #support-sync.
lee (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) scale up inference-runtime-pool-3 by +3 nodes (manual) 2) enable temporary rate-limit on long-seq routes (route: /v1/generate-long) 3) roll traffic to eu-central if needed. following runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eviction-and-kv-pressure (see section "fast mitigation")
maya: scaling up now: `kubectl scale deployment inference-runtime-pool-3 --replicas=8 -n redwood-inference`
maya: noticed OOMKilled on 2 pods before scaling — kernel OOMs, likely memory leak in latest runtime build (sha: ab12cde).
lee (oncall): can we spin a rollback on that daemonset? which deploy introduced it?
maya: runtime deployment 2026-03-14T22:40 (image: rwd-infer:2026.03.14-rc4). I've queued a canary roll back to rc3 on standby nodes.
tj: scaled nodes are coming up, pods reporting Ready. rolling window for 2m to observe.
ops-docs-bot: Runbook step: "If KV cache thrash present, enable prefix caching and reduce per-request kv-size" — link appended.
sophia: support thread: several customers reported increased latency and truncated completions. tagging long-running customers for manual review.
lee (oncall): quick checks: - current 5xx p95: 4.8% (baseline <0.1%) - error class: upstream 502/504 + model infer timeouts - affected: eu-west-1 only so far
maya: logs show burst around 1799989950 -> connection reset errors to local redis cluster (redis-eu-2). Investigating Redis failover events.
tj: I'm rebalancing routing weights: set weight inference-runtime-pool-3=0.5, runtime-2=1.5 for reads. Command: `redwood route set-weight --route /v1/generate --pool inference-runtime-pool-3=0.5`
lee (oncall): good. notify infra to check redis cluster health and failover logs. @sophia can you ping infra?
sophia: pinged infra on pager duty, they acknowledged and are looking at replica sync lag.
ops-docs-bot: Incident note appended to ticket INC-2026-033: "KV cache + redis failover causing upstream 502s"
lee (oncall): temporary customer mitigation: enable fallback model variant with lower memory footprint for high seq routes. Command: `redwood model set-variant --model rwd-large --variant lowmem-temp --route /v1/generate-long`
maya: applying variant now. will take ~45s to propagate.
tj: monitoring traces — tailing request IDs shows degraded completions drop by ~40% after variant applied.
lee (oncall): good. next steps for handoff: - continue watching 5xx for another 20m - infra to confirm redis cluster healthy and confirm root cause - if 5xx drops under 0.2% and no OOMs restart, we'll close page - otherwise plan a rollback of runtime to rc3 and schedule follow-up postmortem
sophia: i'm collating support impact notes and will notify CS with initial customer list + mitigation steps.
lee (oncall): handoff at 1799990375: i'm handing primary to @tj for next 2h. i'll remain reachable as tertiary. summary: scaled pool, applied lowmem model variant, throttled long-seq route weights, infra investigating redis failover. open action items: (1) infra: confirm redis replication lag + fix (2) runtime eng: investigate rc4 memory regression (3) support: follow up to affected customers.
tj: acknowledged, i'm primary now. will take 15m quieter watch and escalate if 5xx > 0.5%
sophia: added support updates and shared draft customer note in #support-sync.
lee (oncall): leaving bridge. good handoff. :white_check_mark: 
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigation in progress, page closed for now (action required / follow-up ticket created)· 1799990375
